item.title: Check out that attic! Circa 1900 in Mississippi. $299,900
item.description: Check out that attic! Have never seen an attic ceiling that tall! The house was built in 1900. It is located in Water Valley, Mississippi. The house features a covered front porch, great back patio, original wood floors, built-ins, tall ceilings, stained glass, picture rails, transom windows, wide baseboards, large bathroom, crown moulding and a great kitchen. What would you do with that attic space? Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,600 square feet. $299,900 Contact Sherry S. Fischer with RE/

item.title: 30 minutes to the beach! Former school. Love the stage with original seating! Over two acres in NC. $375,000
item.description: Interesting property! This former school is only 30 minutes from Nags Head! I love how it has the original auditorium with stage and the original seating! There are lots of possibilities with this property. The school was built in 1930. It is located on 2.75 acres in Stumpy Point, North Carolina. Close to the waterfront and local boat launch. item.title: Porch goals on the Eastern Shore of Virginia. C.1900. $289,900
item.description: Porch goals on the Eastern Shore of Virginia. I like this move in ready house. The home was built in 1900. It is located on .32 acre in Melfa, Virginia. The house features a wrap around front porch, a nice screened in porch, some original wood floors, baseboards and crown moulding. I would pull up the gray vinyl flooring. But this is a a nice house. There is a detached garage on the property. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,546 square feet. $289,900 Contact Andrea S. Zember with Coldwell Ban

item.title: Perfection! Amazing setting! C. 1838. On 96 acres in Virginia. $649,000
item.description: This is perfection! I am in love with the setting, the acreage and the cabin! This cabin was built in 1838. It is located on 96.78 acres in Monroe, Virginia. The house features a covered front porch, stone fireplace, wood floors, log walls, large stone chimney and a cute kitchen. There is a detached storage shed on the property. One bedroom, one bathroom and 762 square feet. $649,000 Contact Jim Faulconer with MCClean Faulconer Reator: 434-981-0076 From the Zillow listing: Tucked away atop Tobac

item.title: Pretty home! Circa 1920 in Virginia. $310,000
item.description: This is a pretty home! I love the yard and the curb appeal! The house was built in 1920. It is located on .42 acre in Keysville, Virginia. The house features a large covered front porch, nice curb appeal, wood floors, transom windows, baseboards, chair rails, bead board wainscoting, updated bathrooms, pretty kitchen and pocket doors. The backyard is fenced and there is a patio. The house could use some carpet remediation. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 3,426 square feet. $310,000 Contact Lonn

item.title: Pretty bathroom and kitchen! Love the outdoor kitchen! C. 1908 in Mississippi. $289,000
item.description: I love the bathroom that has the claw foot tub! The kitchen is nice too! The outdoor fireplace patio is pretty! The house was built in 1908. It is located in Charleston, Mississippi. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, updated kitchen, crown moulding, baseboards, pretty staircase and transom windows. There is a nice patio with fireplace and outdoor kitchen. There is a detached storage shed on the property. Four bedrooms, four bathrooms and 4,533 square feet. $289,000 Contact R

item.title: Interesting house and property! Neat house! On 35 acres in New Jersey. $2,900,000
item.description: This sure is an interesting property. Curious what it was used as. I am assuming some type of resort property? Lots of cabins, campsites, volleyball court and a huge pool. The house was built in 1820. It is located on 35.09 acres in Hackettstown, New Jersey. The house features a large covered front porch, wood floors, crown moulding, bay windows, baseboards, french doors, large stone fireplace, coffered ceiling and arched entryways. item.title: Riverfront property! Almost five acres in New York. $259,900
item.description: This is a pretty house! I wish they showed the riverfront! The house was built in 1890. It is located on 4.8 acres in Brasher Falls, New York. The house features a small covered porch, wood floors, double front doors, leaded glass, baseboards, nice staircase and pocket doors. The house could use a bit of updating, but it is livable so one could work room by room. There is a spacious backyard that leads back to the river. Five bedrooms and three bathrooms. $259,900 Contact Kimberly Moffitt with L

item.title: Nice interior! Circa 1955 in Ohio. $299,900
item.description: This house has a nice interior! There are pretty details! The house was built in 1955. It is located on .81 acre in Hubbard, Ohio. The house features a covered front porch, a lot of natural light, pretty windows, tile entryway, built-in bookshelves, french doors, crown moulding, chair rails, knotty pine and a spacious kitchen.
